review.summary: The change threads a separate `txtbuf_offset` argument through `_leaf_to_Expr` instead of folding the substring offset into `srcrange`. In `_to_expr`, `byte_range(node) .+ offset` previously conflated buffer-relative indices with source-relative indices, so any code path that indexes the SourceFile (e.g. `view(source, srcrange)` for the `@__dot__` MacroName check) got wrong positions when the source text is a SubString. Splitting the offset from the range corrects leaf Expr conversion for substring-backed sources. This reads as a behavior-correcting fix in production code, not a feature or refactor.
review.evidence: Production change limited to src/expr.jl (3 minimized hunks, reported globally minimal with all hunks necessary). Accompanying test change in test/expr.jl. Runtime evidence reports a stable differential across 3 repetitions via a dedicated trigger script, with the full suite passing at the fixed commit, which is consistent with a genuine parent-fails/fixed-passes defect. The semantic delta is visible in the diff: srcrange is no longer pre-offset and the offset is passed separately, so source-relative indexing (view(source, srcrange)) and buffer-relative indexing are no longer conflated; the non-substring call site passes 0, preserving prior behavior there.

The full production patch and the test diff are empty in the payload, so I cannot see the added assertions. trigger_tests is empty, so the specific failing test name is unknown. One original hunk was dropped during minimization and its content is not shown, so I cannot confirm how txtbuf_offset is consumed inside _leaf_to_Expr.
review.validation_risks: The trigger relies on a dedicated script rather than a named test, so mapping it into a Defects4J-style trigger test may need work. Because the parameter addition changes an internal signature, an incorrectly minimized patch could leave txtbuf_offset unused and still compile in Julia, producing a fix that only accidentally works via the srcrange change. Reproduction likely requires parsing from a SubString source; if the trigger constructs input differently the differential may not reproduce.
review.suggested_tests: Parse expressions from a SubString-backed source (e.g. a code string embedded with a leading prefix, wrapped via a SubString/offset SourceFile) and compare the resulting Expr to parsing the same code from a plain String. Specifically cover a leaf whose conversion inspects the source text: the `.` MacroName mapping to `@__dot__` (broadcast fusion like `@. x + y`) at a nonzero substring offset, plus numeric and string literal leaves at nonzero offsets to confirm values and positions match the offset-free baseline.
